decision.observation: The traverse worked: the dark convex slope now fills the lower-right and I'm standing on it, with the pale slab now foreshortened away to the upper left and the crest line dropping toward the right horizon. Reticle is a tiny white dot on the sand. Green about 25%, yellow hatched tail nearly full width.
decision.hypothesis: I've gained the slope's shoulder. Plain W along the contour should keep moving without draining green further; the crest to the right leads somewhere new.
decision.memory: W+D diagonal traverse successfully rode the ridge flank up onto the slope shoulder — this works where straight grabs stall.
